Hello friends!

notes.title: Important Announcement Regarding Our Game Concept
notes.notes:
Hello Friends,

First of all, a big thank you to everyone who played our demo and shared valuable feedback. Your support inspired us to be our best.

We want to address a situation that has come to our attention regarding our game Paranormal VHS and its concept.

Recently, we have become aware that some individuals have copied the demo and concept of Paranormal VHS and attempted to create and sell their own products based on our unique concept. We want to emphasize that Paranormal VHS is an original creation and we have poured our heart and soul into. It is disheartening to see our hard work begin imitated without proper credit or authorization, while also facing accusations of stealing their game concept that was originally created by us.

We want to assure our loyal supporters that we are taking this matter seriously especially for a solo developer like me. We are actively exploring legal options to protect our intellectual property and ensure that our vision remains uncompromised. We value the trust you have placed in us and want to maintain the integrity of the experience we have crafted for you.

As we continue to work on bringing Paranormal VHS to life, we are again grateful for your unwavering support. Your enthusiasm fuels our determination to overcome such challenges and
deliver an amazing gaming experience.

We kindly ask for your continued understanding and patience as we navigate this difficult situation. If you encounter any products that appear to be derived from our concept, we encourage
you to report them to us directly.

Thank you for being a part of our community and for standing by us during this time.

Elite Lords Studios

notes.title: Paranormal VHS Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to the store page!

We would like to introduce our next horror game, Paranormal VHS. 

None of this would have been possible without your support. We want to thank you for supporting our previous game and this journey.

You will be able to test out a demo at Steam Next Fest. Please let us know your thoughts and feedback, as well as any bugs you discover. Please be aware that the demo does not represent the final product's quality.

We hope you enjoyed the trailer and the demo!

The game is currently in development and more information will be provided as the release date approaches.
